user.title: Swiss Parking
user.description: Live free parking spaces from the parking guidance system of a Swiss city. One entry per city — add the integration again for another city. Currently supported: Zürich, Basel, Winterthur, Bern, Frauenfeld, St. Gallen. The car parks at railway stations are offered as SBB P+Rail (estimated occupancy).

stations.title: SBB P+Rail: stations
stations.description: Pick the stations to watch. The occupancy is an estimate by the SBB, refreshed every half hour; free spaces are not counted. Only stations with an estimate are listed.

abort.already_configured: The city or P+Rail is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: The city's parking feed could not be reached.
error.no_garages: The city's parking feed returned no garages.

unreachable.title: Swiss Parking: feed for {city} unreachable
unreachable.description: The parking feed of {city} has not answered, or returned no car parks, for several refreshes in a row. Check your internet connection; if it is fine, the city's feed itself is down. The sensors and map markers stay unavailable until then and recover on their own; this notice disappears with the next successful refresh.
